The survivors are hard capability limits the plan requires to be stated (elves cannot feel the contamination, Jaina cannot read paper), absence-as-evidence in an investigation chapter (swept gaps, no cut edges, no tracks on stone), dialogue answers to direct questions, or the POV's own self-argument. findings.text: The mage didn't ask how far.
findings.deletionTest: Sylvanas heard the mage shift her grip, take up the rein in the wrapped hand and drop the staff back into the crook of the dead arm. The readiness action already carries her compliance with the night-ride order.
findings.reason: Pattern 5. The sentence names the objection she does not raise before giving the real response, which is the grip shift and the rein taken up in the next sentence. None of the four keep conditions applies: no in-scene binary choice, no spatial correction, no world limit, and it is narration rather than Sylvanas arguing with herself.
findings.suggestedFix: Sylvanas heard the mage shift her grip, take up the rein in the wrapped hand and drop the staff back into the crook of the dead arm.
findings.fixNote: Replace both sentences ('The mage didn't ask how far. Sylvanas heard her shift her grip, ...') with the single fixed sentence. 'her' becomes 'the mage' because the deleted sentence was the antecedent. Narration still uses 'the mage' here, as required before Beat 7.

audits.secondSweepP5P6: Re-read every sentence for inanimate or abstract subjects carrying agency, cognition, desire, combustion or physical-behaviour verbs, for receiver nouns with the actor buried in an instrument phrase, for body-part subjects, and for abstract states settling into the body. Road and geography verbs ('ran', 'went', 'fell back', 'opened', 'split', 'bending', 'came up out of it') are all fictive-motion description with no intent. Document verbs ('the sacking said Andorhal', 'the slips said so', 'only the marks said south') report written content literally. 'The fan kept widening at the top' describes the shape the data makes, not a change Sylvanas chose. The staff, crystal and contamination verbs ('the light leaned', 'crowded to one side', 'the boards have it', 'getting sicker the further south it ran') are the chapter's in-world mechanism, so the subject-matter defense applies. No abstract state settles into a body part, and there are no nominalized-verb agents. No noun takes a chain of different human verbs across consecutive sentences. There are two body-part 'stayed' constructions (L79, L391) where the character's deliberate control is handed to the voice or the head. Both are killed below. The other body-part subjects (L39 shoulders came down, L83 head coming round to an unexplained draught, L281 hand already at the bowstring on waking, L577 jaw working and teeth chattering with frost, L651 eyes came open at the light) are involuntary reflexes, and the involuntariness is the point of each sentence.
